doc: GostrictCall calls an exported function of the program of the bundle in the frontend, see the package presentation/ui/program. The frontend keeps an instance of the bundle per instance id and answers with GostrictReturn.

1.doc: Instance identifies the instance of the program in the frontend.
1.name: Instance

2.doc: Bundle is the URL of the program.
2.name: Bundle

3.doc: Name is the exported function. If empty, the frontend drops the instance.
3.name: Name

4.doc: Args are the arguments as a JSON array, see the package presentation/ui/program.
4.name: Args
